items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: Mizuho raised 2027 adj. EBITDA estimate to $3.2B from $2.4B. 16 of 26 analysts rate Buy/Strong Buy. Q3 results Nov 4.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Albemarle Energy Storage Q2 realized price up 61% to $19.53/kg; segment adjusted EBITDA +229% to $723M. Lithium prices recovering from a two-year slump.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Zacks Underperform: weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, rising supply-chain costs.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus keeps Buy; lithium up ~67% y/y but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.
